method: Read the packet (30 accepted, 8 disputes). Rendered every dispute spot with render.py at 0.25 m grid and queried prims.pkl for the exact hatches / lines (wall ends, stub, furring hatch 618, thin glass pieces 60E/69D/603/609); decided each from the geometry, not by votes. Re-measured the accepted openings against their door-block frames, wall-end faces and the 0.12/0.02 wall faces (all within 1 cm). Independent checks for misses: (1) inventory of every INSERT in the box (20 door / opening blocks + 8 toilet stalls = 28 blocks, plus the 2 doorless gaps = the 30 accepted openings), (2) A-DOOR* entities grouped by block handle (no orphan leaves or swings), (3) door-swing arc search (every 90 deg arc lies at an accepted door), (4) a shapely wall-union search for facing wall-end faces across clear gaps of 0.45..3.0 m (46 candidates, every one is an accepted opening, a door-frame pair, a closed pocket, a corridor between blocks, or a room interior), (5) a full render of the part with a mark at every opening plus zoomed panels of the north block, old core, WCs, lift lobby, SE and SW corners. Result: all 30 accepted openings kept (renumbered L29W-01..31 along the walls), one dispute (E-only stair top-landing gap) kept as an optional passage (new L29W-08), the other 7 are not openings (wall end, two corridor mouths for 3; glass side panels of the sliding-door screens moved to glassWalls for 4); nothing new found by the miss check.
